input.advisory: Cisco IOS XE devices with the management web interface enabled are affected by CVE-2023-20198 (CVSS 10.0). An unauthenticated remote attacker can create a privileged account by sending a crafted HTTP request to the management interface and chain it with CVE-2023-20273 to execute commands. Affects IOS XE 16.x through 17.x. Cisco has released patches and recommends disabling the HTTP/HTTPS management interface on internet-facing devices.

expected.summary: Critical unauth account-create + RCE in Cisco IOS XE management web interface (CVE-2023-20198, CVSS 10.0). Patch + disable internet-facing HTTP/HTTPS admin UI.

rationale: Captures severity, CVE, affected component, and primary actionable mitigation in one sentence.

input.advisory: Apple released iOS 17.5.1 to address CVE-2024-27834, a kernel use-after-free that allows arbitrary code execution with kernel privileges. Severity: Critical. Used in active exploitation by commercial spyware vendors targeting journalists and activists. Auto-update is enabled by default; manual users should install via Settings > General > Software Update.

expected.summary: iOS 17.5.1 patches actively-exploited kernel RCE (CVE-2024-27834) used by spyware. Install via auto-update or Settings > General > Software Update.

rationale: Mentions exploit-in-the-wild context and concrete user action.

input.advisory: MongoDB Atlas detected anomalous query patterns from a third-party SaaS integration on April 15, 2024. Customers using MongoDB Atlas with the affected integration enabled may have had query metadata (collection names, query shapes, document counts) — but not document contents — exposed to the integration provider for ~6 hours. No customer credentials were exposed. MongoDB has revoked the integration's access. Affected customers were notified individually.

expected.summary: MongoDB Atlas leaked query metadata (not document contents) to a third-party integration for 6 hours on 2024-04-15. Access revoked; affected customers notified directly.

rationale: Surfaces what was/wasn't exposed and the resolution status.

input.advisory: Slack Enterprise Grid customers should review their SSO configuration following the disclosure of CVE-2024-XXXX (severity: Medium). A misconfiguration in the SAML response validator allowed crafted SAML assertions to authenticate as arbitrary users in workspaces that use SSO with non-default attribute-mapping rules. Slack has patched the validator and recommends all admins rotate the SSO certificate as a precaution. No exploitation observed in customer data.

expected.summary: Medium SAML auth bypass in Slack Enterprise Grid SSO (CVE-2024-XXXX). No exploitation seen; rotate SSO cert as precaution if you use non-default SAML attribute mapping.

rationale: Conditional advice ('if you use non-default mapping') matters for the audience.

input.advisory: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.12.4 patches CVE-2024-XXXX, a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the repository import flow. An authenticated user with permission to import repositories can cause the GHES instance to make HTTP requests to internal infrastructure. Severity: Medium. Affects GHES 3.10-3.12. Upgrade via standard maintenance window. Workaround: restrict repository-import permission to admin-only.

expected.summary: Medium SSRF in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.10–3.12 repo import (CVE-2024-XXXX). Patch to 3.12.4+ or restrict repo-import permission to admins.

rationale: Workaround is concrete and easier than the upgrade for some teams.

input.advisory: Hashicorp Vault 1.16.2 fixes CVE-2024-2660, an authorization bypass in the userpass auth method when handling case-sensitive username comparisons. A user 'Admin' could authenticate as 'admin' on instances where both accounts exist with different policies, gaining the more permissive set. Severity: High. Affects Vault 1.14.0-1.16.1. Fixed in 1.16.2, 1.15.8, 1.14.12. Workaround: ensure no two userpass accounts differ only by case.

expected.summary: High auth bypass in Hashicorp Vault userpass case-sensitivity (CVE-2024-2660). Upgrade to 1.16.2 / 1.15.8 / 1.14.12 or audit for case-collision usernames.

rationale: Audit-style workaround is actionable for teams who can't immediately patch.

input.advisory: Tenable disclosed CVE-2024-XXXX in Nessus Network Monitor: a heap-buffer-overflow in the SNMP packet parser allows a network-adjacent attacker to crash the Nessus scanner. No RCE has been demonstrated. Severity: Medium. Affects all NNM versions before 6.4.0. Workaround: filter SNMP traffic from untrusted segments at the network edge. Fixed in 6.4.0.

expected.summary: Medium DoS in Nessus Network Monitor SNMP parser (CVE-2024-XXXX). Crash only, no RCE. Upgrade to 6.4.0+ or block SNMP from untrusted segments.

rationale: Explicitly notes 'no RCE' so the on-call doesn't over-react.

input.advisory: Stripe published an advisory regarding their webhook signature verification library 'stripe-node' versions 13.x prior to 13.5.0. A regular-expression denial-of-service in the signature header parser allows a malicious caller to consume excessive CPU on webhook endpoints. Severity: Low. Customers using stripe-node should upgrade. Stripe webhooks themselves are not affected — only customer-side servers using the affected library version.

expected.summary: Low ReDoS in stripe-node 13.x <13.5.0 webhook signature parser. Upgrade your stripe-node dependency; Stripe-side infra not affected.

rationale: Clarifies blast radius (customer side, not Stripe itself).

input.advisory: Fortinet has issued an emergency patch for CVE-2024-21762 (CVSS 9.6), an out-of-bounds write in the FortiOS SSL VPN that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. Severity: Critical. Affects FortiOS 7.4.0–7.4.2, 7.2.0–7.2.6, 7.0.0–7.0.13, 6.4.0–6.4.14, 6.2.0–6.2.15, 6.0 all versions. Exploitation observed in the wild against unpatched edges. Patch immediately; if you cannot, disable SSL VPN.

expected.summary: Critical RCE in FortiOS SSL VPN (CVE-2024-21762, CVSS 9.6) actively exploited. Patch immediately or disable SSL VPN.

input.advisory: Microsoft's May 2024 Patch Tuesday addresses 60 vulnerabilities including three zero-days: CVE-2024-30040 (MSHTML platform security feature bypass, exploited in the wild), CVE-2024-30051 (DWM core library elevation of privilege, exploited by QakBot), and CVE-2024-30046 (Visual Studio DoS). Critical issues include CVE-2024-30044 (SharePoint RCE) and CVE-2024-30050 (Windows Mark of the Web bypass). Apply via Windows Update.

expected.summary: May 2024 Patch Tuesday: 60 fixes including 3 zero-days (CVE-2024-30040 MSHTML bypass, CVE-2024-30051 DWM EoP via QakBot, CVE-2024-30046). Apply Windows Update now.

rationale: Lists the 3 zero-days by CVE since on-call needs to verify each.

input.advisory: Atlassian disclosed CVE-2024-1597, a SQL injection vulnerability in Confluence Data Center & Server. The flaw is in the postgresql JDBC driver dependency, not Atlassian code directly. Severity: Critical (CVSS 10.0). Affects Confluence DC & Server prior to 8.8.0. Requires only the ability to send a crafted request to the Confluence instance; no authentication needed. Patch to 8.8.0+ or the LTS line.

expected.summary: Critical unauth SQLi in Confluence DC/Server <8.8.0 via pgjdbc dependency (CVE-2024-1597, CVSS 10.0). Patch to 8.8.0+ immediately.

rationale: Notes the upstream dependency origin since users may already have a separate pgjdbc inventory.

input.advisory: Google Chrome 124.0.6367.207 patches CVE-2024-4671, a use-after-free in Visuals that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted HTML page. Severity: High. Exploitation in the wild reported. Chrome auto-updates; users should restart the browser to apply. Edge, Brave, Opera, and other Chromium-based browsers will follow with their own releases.

expected.summary: High Chrome UAF RCE (CVE-2024-4671) exploited in the wild. Restart Chrome 124.0.6367.207+ to apply; Chromium-based browsers will release follow-ups.

rationale: Restart instruction is the often-missed user action.

input.advisory: OpenSSL 3.0.13, 3.1.5, and 3.2.1 fix CVE-2024-0727, a denial-of-service triggered by processing PKCS12 files with a NULL ContentInfo field. Severity: Moderate. Most applications using OpenSSL to verify or unpack PKCS12 files from untrusted sources are affected. Workaround: validate PKCS12 file structure before passing to OpenSSL. Upgrade is recommended at the next maintenance window.

expected.summary: Moderate DoS in OpenSSL PKCS12 parsing (CVE-2024-0727). Patch to 3.0.13 / 3.1.5 / 3.2.1, or pre-validate PKCS12 from untrusted sources.

rationale: Lists all three patched lines; mentions pre-validation as a code-side fallback.

input.advisory: Kubernetes 1.30.0 fixes CVE-2024-3177 in kubelet: a bypass of the mountable secrets policy enforced by the ServiceAccount admission plugin. An attacker with permission to create a Pod can mount any secret in the namespace. Severity: Low. Affects kubelet 1.26 - 1.29.x. Patched in 1.30, 1.29.4, 1.28.9, 1.27.13, 1.26.16.

expected.summary: Low Pod-secret bypass in Kubernetes kubelet 1.26–1.29 (CVE-2024-3177). Upgrade to 1.30 / 1.29.4 / 1.28.9 / 1.27.13 / 1.26.16.

rationale: Lists all patched lines so cluster owners on an LTS line can find theirs.

input.advisory: F5 has published K000139404 for CVE-2024-XXXX, an authentication bypass in the BIG-IP Next Central Manager API. A remote attacker can issue API calls without valid credentials and create persistent admin accounts. Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.8). Affects BIG-IP Next Central Manager 20.0.1–20.1.0. Engineering hotfix available; full patch in 20.2.0. F5 recommends restricting Central Manager API access to trusted networks pending the patch.

expected.summary: Critical unauth API + admin-account creation in F5 BIG-IP Next Central Manager 20.0.1–20.1.0 (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 9.8). Apply hotfix or wait for 20.2.0; restrict API to trusted networks.

rationale: Distinguishes engineering hotfix vs full release.

input.advisory: Citrix has published an advisory for CVE-2023-4966 ('Citrix Bleed') in NetScaler ADC and Gateway. The vulnerability allows session token theft via a buffer over-read in the Gateway service. Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.4). Mass exploitation observed since October 2023 by ransomware affiliates including LockBit. Patched versions: NetScaler 14.1-8.50, 13.1-49.15, 13.1-FIPS 13.1-37.164, 13.0-92.19, 13.0-FIPS 13.0-92.21. After patching, you must terminate all active sessions to evict stolen tokens.

expected.summary: Critical session-token theft in Citrix NetScaler/Gateway ('Citrix Bleed', CVE-2023-4966) mass-exploited by ransomware. Patch + terminate all active sessions afterward.

rationale: Surface 'kill sessions after patch' — patching alone leaves stolen tokens valid.

input.advisory: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.59 fixes CVE-2024-27316, an HTTP/2 request smuggling vulnerability via the CONTINUATION frame. Memory exhaustion DoS possible. Severity: High. Affects all 2.4.x prior to 2.4.59. Workaround: disable HTTP/2 on the server. Fixed by patching.

expected.summary: High HTTP/2 CONTINUATION-frame request smuggling + DoS in Apache httpd <2.4.59 (CVE-2024-27316). Upgrade or disable HTTP/2.

rationale: Workaround (disable HTTP/2) is broadly applicable when patching is delayed.

input.advisory: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure gateways are affected by CVE-2024-21887, a command injection allowing an authenticated administrator to execute commands as root. Severity: High. Chained with CVE-2024-21888 (authentication bypass), unauthenticated RCE is possible. Both chained CVEs are under mass exploitation by Chinese state-affiliated actors as of January 2024. Apply mitigation XML and patches per vendor advisory.

expected.summary: Mass-exploited unauth RCE chain in Ivanti Connect/Policy Secure (CVE-2024-21887 + CVE-2024-21888). Apply mitigation XML and patches immediately.

rationale: Chain context + 'apply XML mitigation' is the well-known Ivanti specific.

input.advisory: Linux kernel 6.8.7 patches CVE-2024-1086, a use-after-free in the netfilter nf_tables component. A local attacker with the ability to create network namespaces can escalate to root. Severity: High (CVSS 7.8). Public exploit available. Affects kernel 5.14 onwards. Distro vendors are shipping backports; check your distro advisories.

expected.summary: High local-to-root via netfilter nf_tables UAF in Linux kernel 5.14+ (CVE-2024-1086) with public exploit. Apply distro kernel backports.

rationale: Public-exploit note + 'check distro' acknowledges most users don't run vanilla kernels.

input.advisory: Docker Desktop 4.30.0 patches CVE-2024-XXXX, an information disclosure in the Docker Desktop GUI that exposed signed-in account tokens to logs in unattended state. Severity: Low. Tokens were not transmitted to third parties but were available in log files on the local filesystem. Users should upgrade and rotate Docker Hub tokens issued before April 2024 as a precaution.

expected.summary: Low token-leak-to-local-logs in Docker Desktop pre-4.30 (CVE-2024-XXXX). Upgrade and rotate pre-April-2024 Docker Hub tokens.

rationale: Limited blast radius (local logs only) but token rotation is the operationally important step.

input.advisory: MOVEit Transfer 2024.0.1 fixes CVE-2024-XXXX, an authentication bypass affecting the SFTP module. An unauthenticated attacker can bypass the SFTP login flow when the LDAP authentication module is configured with specific options. Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.1). Progress Software notes that no exploitation has been observed but recommends immediate patching given MOVEit's prior history as a ransomware target.

expected.summary: Critical unauth SFTP auth bypass in MOVEit Transfer (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 9.1) when LDAP is configured a certain way. Patch to 2024.0.1 immediately.

rationale: Mentions 'history as ransomware target' nudges urgency.

input.advisory: WordPress core 6.5.3 patches a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the comment editor allowing low-privileged users (contributors) to inject scripts that execute when an admin previews. Severity: Medium. Affects WordPress 6.0–6.5.2. Auto-update applies; if auto-updates are disabled, upgrade via Dashboard > Updates.

expected.summary: Medium stored XSS in WordPress comment editor 6.0–6.5.2 (escalates contributor → admin context). Upgrade to 6.5.3 via auto-update or Dashboard > Updates.

rationale: Privilege escalation context (contributor → admin) clarifies why a 'comment' XSS matters.

input.advisory: PostgreSQL 16.3, 15.7, 14.12, 13.15, and 12.19 fix CVE-2024-4317, a missing permission check in pg_stats_ext_exprs allowing unprivileged users to read pg_statistic_ext_data contents from arbitrary tables. Severity: Low. Affects PG 14–16; 12 and 13 are not affected but are receiving routine updates. Patch via the normal minor-version upgrade path.

expected.summary: Low pg_stats_ext_exprs permission-check miss in PostgreSQL 14–16 (CVE-2024-4317). Upgrade to 16.3 / 15.7 / 14.12 (12/13 unaffected).

rationale: Calls out 12/13 explicitly so on-call doesn't waste a maintenance window.

input.advisory: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS 11.1.2-h3, 11.0.4-h1, and 10.2.9-h1 fix CVE-2024-3400, a command injection in the GlobalProtect feature when device telemetry is enabled. Severity: Critical (CVSS 10.0). Exploitation in the wild since March 2024 by multiple threat actors. Workaround: disable device telemetry. Patches available; PAN-OS 9.x and earlier not affected.

expected.summary: Critical zero-day RCE in PAN-OS GlobalProtect telemetry path (CVE-2024-3400, CVSS 10.0) actively exploited. Patch to 11.1.2-h3 / 11.0.4-h1 / 10.2.9-h1 or disable device telemetry.

rationale: Workaround (disable telemetry) is the critical interim mitigation.

input.advisory: VMware ESXi 8.0 U2c addresses CVE-2024-22273, a heap out-of-bounds write in the storage controller emulation. A guest VM with administrator privileges can exploit this to execute code in the ESXi hypervisor process. Severity: High (CVSS 8.1). Workaround: detach unused virtual storage controllers from VMs. Affects ESXi 7.0 and 8.0 lines; patches available for both.

expected.summary: High guest-to-hypervisor escape via storage controller in ESXi 7.0/8.0 (CVE-2024-22273, CVSS 8.1). Patch or detach unused virtual storage controllers.

rationale: Guest-to-host escape is the alarming framing — be explicit.

input.advisory: An NPM advisory notes that the popular package 'event-stream' has had an unauthorized maintainer commit pushing a malicious payload to versions 3.3.6 and 3.3.7. The malicious code attempted to exfiltrate Bitcoin wallet keys from one specific downstream application ('copay'). The package has been unpublished; npm has removed affected versions. Audit your lockfiles for event-stream 3.3.6 or 3.3.7.

expected.summary: Supply-chain: npm 'event-stream' 3.3.6/3.3.7 contained wallet-key exfiltration code targeting 'copay'. Removed from registry; audit lockfiles for those versions.

rationale: Action: audit lockfiles for the specific version range.

input.advisory: AWS published a security bulletin about a misconfigured IAM trust policy template that was used by some customers via a third-party Terraform module. The template allowed assume-role from a wildcard external account ID. AWS does not consider this an AWS vulnerability — the third-party module is the affected component. Customers should audit IAM trust policies for wildcard `Principal.AWS` values.

expected.summary: Third-party Terraform module created IAM trust policies with wildcard external account access; not an AWS vuln. Audit `Principal.AWS` for wildcards across roles.

rationale: Identifies who's responsible (the module, not AWS) + the audit query.

input.advisory: Cisco published an advisory for CVE-2024-20356 in Cisco Integrated Management Controller (IMC) covering UCS C-series rack servers. An authenticated administrator can execute commands at the underlying OS level via a flaw in the web management interface. Severity: Medium (CVSS 8.8). Affects firmware 4.2 and earlier. Patches available; no workaround. Admin access is required, so risk is constrained to environments where IMC admin credentials are not strictly controlled.

expected.summary: Medium auth'd cmd-injection in Cisco UCS IMC web UI (CVE-2024-20356, CVSS 8.8). Patch firmware; risk scales with IMC-admin-credential exposure.

input.advisory: Jenkins core 2.442 and LTS 2.426.3 patch CVE-2024-23897, a path traversal in the Jenkins CLI parser allowing unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files from the Jenkins controller filesystem. Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.8). Active exploitation reported within days of disclosure to harvest credentials.txt and secret keys. Disable the CLI over SSH and HTTP if patching is delayed.

expected.summary: Critical unauth file-read via Jenkins CLI parser (CVE-2024-23897, CVSS 9.8) being mass-exploited for credentials. Patch to 2.442 / LTS 2.426.3, or disable CLI.

input.advisory: Microsoft Exchange Server April 2024 SU updates address CVE-2024-21413 ('Moniker Link') affecting Outlook on Windows. A specially crafted email containing a moniker link can result in NTLM credential leakage when previewed. Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.8). Apply Outlook + Exchange SUs in tandem; mitigation: outbound NTLM blocking at the perimeter.

expected.summary: Critical NTLM credential leak via Outlook 'moniker link' email preview (CVE-2024-21413, CVSS 9.8). Apply April 2024 SUs to Outlook + Exchange; block outbound NTLM.

rationale: Outlook + Exchange must be patched together for full coverage.

input.advisory: Splunk Enterprise 9.2.1, 9.1.4, and 9.0.9 patch CVE-2024-29945, an authentication token disclosure when SplunkWeb runs in debug mode. Severity: High. Debug mode is not enabled by default but is common in development environments. Affected environments should rotate Splunk auth tokens after patching.

expected.summary: High auth-token disclosure in Splunk Enterprise debug-mode (CVE-2024-29945). Patch to 9.2.1 / 9.1.4 / 9.0.9 and rotate tokens if debug was ever on.

input.advisory: Oracle's April 2024 Critical Patch Update addresses 441 vulnerabilities across the product line. Highest-severity items: CVE-2024-XXXX in Oracle E-Business Suite (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2024-XXXX in MySQL Cluster (CVSS 9.1), and seven critical Java SE flaws. Many are remotely exploitable without authentication. Apply via Oracle Support per product line.

expected.summary: Oracle April 2024 CPU: 441 fixes; critical unauth RCEs in E-Business Suite + MySQL Cluster + Java SE. Schedule patching per product line.

input.advisory: Mozilla Firefox 125.0.3 patches CVE-2024-XXXX, an integer overflow in the SVG path renderer that can be triggered by a malicious page to corrupt memory and potentially execute code. Severity: High. Mozilla rates exploit difficulty as 'high' and notes no in-the-wild exploitation observed. Auto-update applies; manual upgrade via Help > About Firefox.

expected.summary: High SVG-path memory-corruption RCE in Firefox <125.0.3 (CVE-2024-XXXX); no in-the-wild exploitation. Restart browser to apply update.

rationale: Distinguishes 'theoretical' from 'actively exploited' so urgency is calibrated.

input.advisory: JetBrains TeamCity On-Premises 2023.11.4 fixes CVE-2024-27198 (authentication bypass) and CVE-2024-27199 (path traversal). The auth bypass allows full administrative API access without credentials and is being actively exploited as of March 2024 to deploy ransomware. All on-prem TeamCity servers prior to 2023.11.4 must be patched immediately. TeamCity Cloud is not affected.

expected.summary: Critical unauth TeamCity On-Prem auth bypass (CVE-2024-27198) + path traversal (CVE-2024-27199) actively exploited for ransomware. Patch to 2023.11.4. Cloud unaffected.

input.advisory: Spring Framework 6.1.6, 6.0.19, and 5.3.34 fix CVE-2024-22262, an open-redirect vulnerability in UriComponentsBuilder when handling URLs with embedded credentials. Severity: Medium. Some applications use UriComponentsBuilder for validation; if so, attacker-controlled URLs may be considered 'safe' incorrectly. Audit any validate-then-redirect flow.

expected.summary: Medium open-redirect via Spring's UriComponentsBuilder URL parser (CVE-2024-22262). Patch to 6.1.6 / 6.0.19 / 5.3.34 and audit redirect-validation paths.

rationale: Audit hint is the on-the-ground actionable for app teams.

input.advisory: GitLab Community and Enterprise Edition 16.11.2, 16.10.5, and 16.9.7 patch CVE-2023-7028, a password-reset email hijack that lets unauthenticated attackers send password-reset emails for any account to attacker-controlled addresses. Severity: Critical (CVSS 10.0). Exploitation observed in the wild. Patch immediately or disable email-based password resets. 2FA does not protect against this — the reset flow precedes 2FA.

expected.summary: Critical GitLab account takeover via password-reset hijack (CVE-2023-7028, CVSS 10.0) exploited in wild; 2FA does NOT mitigate. Patch to 16.11.2 / 16.10.5 / 16.9.7 or disable email password resets.

rationale: '2FA does not protect' is the critical misconception to surface.

input.advisory: Akamai disclosed that on May 3, 2024, a content delivery misconfiguration caused encrypted backups of some customer-uploaded files to be served with a stale ACL for 90 minutes. Files remained encrypted; no decryption key was exposed. Akamai has rotated the ACL service and notified affected accounts. Recommendation: audit access logs for the window if you have stricter compliance requirements.

expected.summary: Akamai stale-ACL exposure of encrypted (not plaintext) customer backups for 90 min on 2024-05-03; ACL service rotated, affected accounts notified. Audit access logs if compliance requires.

rationale: What was/wasn't exposed + the conditional log audit.

input.advisory: Pulse Connect Secure 9.1R18.2, 22.4R1, and 22.5R1.1 patch CVE-2024-XXXX, a server-side template injection in the administrative UI. An authenticated administrator can execute commands as root. Severity: High. CVSS 8.8. Pulse VPN appliances have a history of being targeted; even auth-required vulns warrant prompt patching. Apply via the standard firmware update flow.

expected.summary: High auth'd RCE via SSTI in Pulse Connect Secure admin UI (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 8.8). Patch to 9.1R18.2 / 22.4R1 / 22.5R1.1; Pulse appliances are recurring ransomware targets.

input.advisory: Trellix Endpoint Security disclosed CVE-2024-XXXX, a TOCTOU race condition during quarantine release that allows a local user to write arbitrary files as SYSTEM on Windows. Severity: High (CVSS 7.8). Affects ENS 10.7.0 through 10.7.0 build 8163. Patched in ENS 10.7.0 build 8166. No workaround; deploy via standard endpoint management.

expected.summary: High local-to-SYSTEM TOCTOU during Trellix ENS quarantine release on Windows (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 7.8). Patch to ENS 10.7.0 build 8166.

rationale: Endpoint-product vulns matter because the agent is privileged.

input.advisory: Redis 7.2.5, 7.0.15, and 6.2.14 fix CVE-2024-31449, a denial-of-service via stack overflow in the Lua scripting engine when handling deeply nested arrays. Severity: Medium. Workaround: disable Lua scripting (`set-script-engine off`). All Redis versions before the fixed releases are affected when Lua scripting is enabled (default).

expected.summary: Medium DoS via Lua nested-array stack overflow in Redis <7.2.5 / <7.0.15 / <6.2.14 (CVE-2024-31449). Upgrade or disable Lua scripting.

rationale: Default-on context matters; many ops only know to disable Lua if reminded.

input.advisory: Apache Struts 2.5.33 and 6.3.0.2 patch CVE-2023-50164, a file-upload path traversal allowing remote code execution via OGNL injection. Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.8). Affected applications must use `FileUploadInterceptor` (default in most uploads). Active exploitation since December 2023 by ransomware groups. Patch immediately or remove the FileUploadInterceptor temporarily.

expected.summary: Critical OGNL-injection RCE via path traversal in Apache Struts FileUploadInterceptor (CVE-2023-50164, CVSS 9.8) actively exploited. Patch to 2.5.33 / 6.3.0.2 or remove the interceptor.

rationale: OGNL is well-known shorthand for Struts RCE pattern; useful framing.

input.advisory: Adobe ColdFusion 2023.6 and 2021.12 patch CVE-2024-20767, an improper access control allowing unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files on the server. Severity: High (CVSS 7.4). CISA added this to the KEV catalog within a week of disclosure. Patch immediately and rotate any secrets stored in files that could have been read (database creds, API keys).

expected.summary: High unauth file-read in Adobe ColdFusion 2023/2021 (CVE-2024-20767, CVSS 7.4) on CISA KEV. Patch to 2023.6 / 2021.12 and rotate secrets potentially leaked from file reads.

rationale: Post-patch credential rotation matters when the vuln exposed files.

input.advisory: Microsoft Azure published a security advisory regarding Azure DevOps. A privilege escalation flaw allowed a user with project-administrator rights to gain organization-administrator rights via a misconfigured permission inheritance. Severity: Medium. Patched server-side; no customer action required for Azure DevOps Services. Azure DevOps Server (on-prem) customers should apply the May 2024 quarterly update.

expected.summary: Medium project-admin → org-admin EoP in Azure DevOps; ADO Services patched server-side, ADO Server (on-prem) needs May 2024 quarterly update.

input.advisory: Synology DiskStation DSM 7.2.1-69057 Update 5 patches CVE-2024-XXXX in the SMB Service. An unauthenticated attacker on the same network can crash the SMB service. Severity: Medium (CVSS 7.5). Crash only — no RCE established. Auto-update via DSM should apply within 24h; users with auto-update disabled should patch manually via Control Panel > Update & Restore.

expected.summary: Medium SMB-service DoS (no RCE) in Synology DSM 7.2.1 pre-Update 5 (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 7.5). Auto-update applies; manual via Control Panel > Update & Restore.

rationale: No-RCE callout calibrates urgency for home/SMB users.

input.advisory: 1Password disclosed that on January 30, 2024, signing logs for 1Password.com customers were briefly accessible from an internal employee endpoint that had been compromised in the Okta support-system breach. Vault contents and unlock secrets were NOT exposed. 1Password recommends rotating Secret Keys for customers who used internal admin tools during the window; instructions sent individually to affected accounts.

expected.summary: 1Password sign-in logs (not vault contents) briefly exposed on 2024-01-30 via Okta-breach-related employee endpoint compromise. Rotate Secret Keys per individual instructions if affected.

rationale: Clear delineation: logs leaked, vaults did not.

input.advisory: Apache ActiveMQ 5.18.3, 5.17.6, 5.16.7 patch CVE-2023-46604, an OpenWire deserialization flaw allowing remote unauthenticated RCE. Severity: Critical (CVSS 10.0). HelloKitty and other ransomware affiliates exploited this through Q4 2023 / Q1 2024. Patch immediately. Workaround: restrict OpenWire transport to trusted networks.

expected.summary: Critical unauth OpenWire deserialization RCE in Apache ActiveMQ (CVE-2023-46604, CVSS 10.0) actively exploited by HelloKitty. Patch to 5.18.3 / 5.17.6 / 5.16.7 or restrict OpenWire.

rationale: Named ransomware group raises urgency for SOCs.

input.advisory: NVIDIA published a security bulletin for the Triton Inference Server, CVE-2024-XXXX. A path traversal in the model repository API allows an attacker with network access to read or write arbitrary files in the server process's directory. Severity: High (CVSS 8.1). Affects Triton 23.04 - 24.04. Patched in 24.05. Workaround: place Triton behind an authenticated reverse proxy.

expected.summary: High path-traversal file r/w in NVIDIA Triton Inference Server 23.04–24.04 (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 8.1). Upgrade to 24.05 or front with authenticated proxy.

rationale: Reverse-proxy mitigation matches how Triton is typically deployed.

input.advisory: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint flagged a campaign where threat actors abuse the BitLocker recovery key feature for ransomware. Defense: block 'manage-bde' usage by non-admins via WDAC; monitor BitLocker policy changes.

expected.summary: Threat campaign abuses legitimate BitLocker as ransomware (not a CVE). Block non-admin `manage-bde` via WDAC; monitor BitLocker policy changes.

rationale: Not-a-CVE framing prevents wasted patching effort; the defense is policy-side.

input.advisory: Sophos Firewall 19.5 MR4 fixes CVE-2024-XXXX, a stored cross-site scripting in the captive portal user message. An attacker who can reach the captive portal can inject scripts that execute in administrator browsers when reviewing portal activity. Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.7). Affects 19.0–19.5 MR3. Patch via standard appliance update; no workaround other than disabling the user-message customization.

expected.summary: Medium stored XSS in Sophos Firewall captive-portal user message (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 6.7). Patch to 19.5 MR4 or disable user-message customization.

rationale: Workaround mentioned explicitly because firewalls don't always patch on Cisco-grade cadence.

input.advisory: GoDaddy disclosed a multi-year compromise of its cPanel hosting environment. From late 2020 through December 2022, attackers had access that allowed them to install malicious code redirecting some customer websites. GoDaddy attributes the compromise to a sophisticated, persistent actor. Customers should review hosting account file integrity, rotate hosting account passwords, and enable 2FA if not already in place.

expected.summary: GoDaddy multi-year (2020–2022) cPanel compromise enabled malicious redirects on some hosted sites. Audit hosting account file integrity, rotate passwords, enable 2FA.

input.advisory: Veeam Backup & Replication 12.1.2.172 patches CVE-2024-29849, an authentication bypass allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to log in via the Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager web interface. Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.8). Public PoC available. Affects 12.x prior to 12.1.2.172. Patch immediately; Veeam backup servers are recurring ransomware targets because of backup-destruction implications.

expected.summary: Critical unauth login in Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager (CVE-2024-29849, CVSS 9.8) with public PoC. Patch to 12.1.2.172; backup servers are common ransomware targets.

input.advisory: Drupal core 10.2.7 and 10.1.10 fix CVE-2024-XXXX, a cross-site request forgery in the modules/themes installer pages. Requires admin-level victim; could lead to arbitrary module installation. Severity: Moderately Critical. Affects 10.0–10.2.6. Patch via composer update; users on Drupal 7 are unaffected (separate codebase).

expected.summary: Moderately Critical CSRF in Drupal 10.0–10.2.6 module installer (CVE-2024-XXXX). Patch to 10.2.7 / 10.1.10 via composer; Drupal 7 unaffected.

input.advisory: Kerberos Distribution Center (KDC) in MIT Kerberos 1.21.3 fixes CVE-2024-26458, a memory leak in the GSS-API mechanism that under sustained attack could degrade KDC performance and lead to a denial-of-service. Severity: Medium. Affects 1.21.0 through 1.21.2. Vendor distros (RHEL, Debian, Ubuntu) backport; check your distro security advisory.

expected.summary: Medium GSS-API memory-leak DoS in MIT Kerberos 1.21.0–1.21.2 (CVE-2024-26458). Patch via distro backports.

rationale: Most Kerberos installs are distro-managed; backport reminder is key.

input.advisory: GitLab Duo Workflow (preview) has been confirmed vulnerable to indirect prompt injection through repository content. A malicious commit message or README can cause Duo Workflow to execute attacker-suggested instructions when an unrelated user runs it. Severity: Medium. GitLab has implemented additional system-prompt hardening as of May 2024 and recommends Duo Workflow preview users review trust posture for unreviewed repositories.

expected.summary: Medium indirect prompt injection in GitLab Duo Workflow (preview) via repo content. System-prompt hardening shipped May 2024; review trust on unreviewed repos.

rationale: LLM-product class of vuln — describe the class accurately.

input.advisory: Cloudflare's RBAC bypass advisory (CVE-2024-XXXX) describes a flaw where users with the 'Cloudflare Workers Deploy' role could read environment secrets attached to other workers in the same account but in different folders. Severity: High. The flaw existed for 6 months prior to discovery. Cloudflare patched server-side, audited access logs, and notified accounts whose secrets had been accessed.

expected.summary: High Cloudflare Workers RBAC bypass that exposed cross-folder secrets to deploy-role users (CVE-2024-XXXX). Patched server-side; notified accounts saw secret access.

rationale: Cross-folder leak + notification implies named-victim disclosures.

input.advisory: OpenSSH 9.6 patches CVE-2023-48795 ('Terrapin'), a prefix-truncation vulnerability in the SSH protocol that downgrades certain encryption integrity features. Severity: Low to Medium depending on connection. Attacker must have an active machine-in-the-middle position. Practical impact: limited downgrade of certificate-based and ChaCha20-Poly1305 hardening. Patch OpenSSH + audit MITRE.org Terrapin scanners on your fleet.

expected.summary: Low-Medium SSH Terrapin prefix-truncation downgrade (CVE-2023-48795) requires active MITM. Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.6 fleet-wide; scan with Terrapin checkers.

input.advisory: Cisco Meraki MX security appliances received firmware MX 18.1.1 to address CVE-2024-XXXX, an unauthenticated request-flood DoS that can be triggered against the local management UI when reachable from a LAN segment. Severity: Medium. By default the management UI is not reachable from outside the LAN. Workaround: ensure management UI is restricted to admin VLANs.

expected.summary: Medium unauth LAN-side mgmt-UI DoS in Cisco Meraki MX <MX 18.1.1 (CVE-2024-XXXX). Patch or scope mgmt UI to admin VLANs.

input.advisory: Twilio published a service incident disclosing that on June 1, 2024, due to an internal misconfiguration, the SendGrid Email Activity Feed exposed inbound webhook payloads from one customer to one other customer for approximately 4 hours. The two affected customers have been individually notified. No bulk customer data was exposed. Twilio has added a regression test to prevent recurrence.

expected.summary: Twilio SendGrid cross-customer webhook payload exposure (2 customers, 4h, 2024-06-01); both directly notified, regression test added.

input.advisory: Kubernetes Dashboard 2.7.1 fixes CVE-2024-XXXX, an authentication-token-disclosure-via-error-message vulnerability. A user with permission to create Pods can craft a Pod spec that causes the dashboard backend to log a service-account token in error output, which is then visible to anyone with cluster log read access. Severity: Medium.

expected.summary: Medium SA-token disclosure via error-log path in Kubernetes Dashboard <2.7.1 (CVE-2024-XXXX). Patch; rotate tokens if cluster logs are widely readable.

rationale: Conditional rotation when log readers are not minimal.

input.advisory: RubyGems disclosed that the 'fastlane-plugin-test' (typosquat of 'fastlane') package on rubygems.org contained code that exfiltrated environment variables to an attacker-controlled URL. The package was downloaded ~120 times before takedown. RubyGems removed the package, banned the publisher, and notified accounts that downloaded it.

expected.summary: Supply-chain: typosquat 'fastlane-plugin-test' on RubyGems exfiltrated env vars (120 downloads). Removed; rotate any env-var secrets if you installed it.

rationale: Env-var rotation is the operationally important downstream step.

input.advisory: Microsoft Azure announced that a researcher discovered a way to enumerate private Container Registry images via an underprivileged identity within the same tenant when ACR firewall was set to 'Allow trusted Microsoft services'. Severity: Medium. Azure has tightened the trusted-services exception. Customers using this exception should audit access logs for unexpected image reads.

expected.summary: Medium Azure Container Registry private-image enumeration via 'trusted Microsoft services' firewall exception (now tightened). Audit ACR access logs.

rationale: Specific feature flag named so admins can verify their config.

input.advisory: Zoom Desktop Client 5.16.5 patches CVE-2024-XXXX, an improper input validation in the screen-share annotation feature that allows a meeting participant to crash other participants' clients by sending malformed annotation packets. Severity: Low. Crash only; no RCE. Affects Windows and macOS clients before 5.16.5; mobile not affected.

expected.summary: Low screen-share annotation DoS (crash only) in Zoom Desktop <5.16.5 on Win/Mac (CVE-2024-XXXX). Update client; mobile unaffected.

rationale: Platform scope + no-RCE keeps urgency right-sized.

input.advisory: Cisco Talos published research on the 'GhostEmperor' threat actor campaign targeting unpatched Microsoft Exchange Servers. The campaign uses a known ProxyLogon-class exploit chain. expected.summary: GhostEmperor campaign targeting unpatched Exchange via ProxyLogon-class chain (research, not new CVE). Apply latest Exchange CU + SU; Defender detects loader IOCs.

input.advisory: Apache Tomcat 11.0.0-M19, 10.1.20, 9.0.85, and 8.5.99 fix CVE-2024-23672, a DoS via the WebSocket implementation where a client can cause server threads to hang indefinitely. expected.summary: Medium WebSocket thread-hang DoS in Apache Tomcat (CVE-2024-23672). Upgrade to 11.0.0-M19 / 10.1.20 / 9.0.85 / 8.5.99 or disable WebSockets.

rationale: All four maintained lines spelled out.

input.advisory: WinSCP 6.3.3 patches CVE-2024-XXXX, a flaw where the .ini file format parser mishandles certain quoted strings, leading to potential code execution if a user opens a malicious .ini configuration. expected.summary: Medium WinSCP malicious-.ini code execution via parser flaw (CVE-2024-XXXX); requires user to open attacker file. Update to 6.3.3.

input.advisory: ZDI published an advisory for D-Link DIR-X4860 routers, CVE-2024-XXXX, a hardcoded credential in the HNAP1 binary allowing remote attackers in the LAN to gain administrator access. expected.summary: High hardcoded admin creds in D-Link DIR-X4860 router HNAP1 (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 8.8); EOL — no patch. Replace device.

rationale: EOL framing is the actionable: no fix coming.

input.advisory: Apache Solr 9.5.0 and 8.11.3 patch CVE-2024-XXXX, an unrestricted file upload in the ConfigSet API that an authenticated administrator can use to upload arbitrary files into the search index path. Severity: High. Could be chained with read-side access to achieve RCE. Patch via standard package update; no workaround other than restricting ConfigSet API permissions further.

expected.summary: High auth'd file-upload-to-RCE chain in Apache Solr ConfigSet API (CVE-2024-XXXX). Patch to 9.5.0 / 8.11.3 or tighten ConfigSet admin scope.

rationale: Chain context (file upload alone is not RCE but combined is).

input.advisory: QNAP TS-x73A NAS firmware 5.1.7 fixes CVE-2024-XXXX, a command injection in the share-folder name validator. Authenticated administrators can execute commands as root. expected.summary: High auth'd cmd-injection via share-folder name in QNAP TS-x73A <5.1.7 (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 8.0). Patch + enable auto-update.

rationale: Auto-update recommendation matches QNAP's typical guidance.

input.advisory: Microsoft Office published advisory for CVE-2024-XXXX, a use-after-free in the OneNote rendering engine triggered by malicious .one files. Severity: High. expected.summary: High OneNote UAF RCE (CVE-2024-XXXX) exploited in Lokibot phishing. Apply June 2024 Office update; block .one attachments at gateway if not needed.

rationale: Email-gateway block is operational reality for many security teams.

expected.summary: Low Cloud SQL Auth Proxy 2.10.1 cross-project audit-log entries (no data leak). Upgrade to 2.10.2; review audit logs for compliance.

input.advisory: Apache OFBiz 18.12.13 fixes CVE-2024-32113, a path traversal in the request-mapping handler allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute commands. expected.summary: Critical unauth path-traversal RCE in Apache OFBiz <18.12.13 (CVE-2024-32113, CVSS 9.8) exploited within 48h. Patch or block `..` at LB.

input.advisory: Bitwarden Server 2024.5.1 patches CVE-2024-XXXX, a privilege check missing on the admin-API endpoint that allows organization members with the 'export vault' permission to also reset other members' passwords. expected.summary: Medium privilege check miss in Bitwarden self-hosted admin API (CVE-2024-XXXX). Self-hosters upgrade to 2024.5.1; cloud already patched.

input.advisory: Mitsubishi Electric MELSEC iQ-R series PLCs are affected by CVE-2024-XXXX, an authentication bypass in the firmware update interface. Operators should segment ICS networks and verify firmware integrity post-incident.

expected.summary: Critical unauth firmware-push on Mitsubishi MELSEC iQ-R PLCs (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 9.8; CISA ICSA-24-XXX-XX). Apply vendor firmware; segment ICS network.

rationale: ICS context: segmentation matters as much as patching.

input.advisory: Cloudflare R2 object storage had a 12-hour partial-availability incident on May 11, 2024 caused by an internal misconfiguration in the metadata service. No data loss occurred. expected.summary: Cloudflare R2 12h partial-availability incident on 2024-05-11 (metadata service); no data loss, known-key reads worked. Postmortem published.

rationale: Availability incident, not a security vuln — frame accurately.

input.advisory: PyPI removed 'requests-toolbelt-tracking' after researchers found it was a typosquat exfiltrating PII from terminal sessions on package install. expected.summary: Supply-chain: typosquat 'requests-toolbelt-tracking' on PyPI exfiltrated terminal PII (800 dl, 2024-04-22 to 2024-05-03). Removed; notified orgs that downloaded — rotate any creds typed in that window.

input.advisory: Cisco ASA 9.20.2.10 patches CVE-2024-20353, a denial-of-service in the WebVPN client where an unauthenticated attacker can crash the device by sending crafted HTTP headers. Severity: High (CVSS 8.6). Workaround: disable WebVPN if not used. Active exploitation observed by state-affiliated actors targeting older ASA versions.

expected.summary: High unauth WebVPN DoS in Cisco ASA <9.20.2.10 (CVE-2024-20353, CVSS 8.6) exploited by state actors. Patch or disable WebVPN.

input.advisory: WP Plugin 'Forminator' 1.31.0 fixes CVE-2024-XXXX, an unauthenticated arbitrary file-upload vulnerability that allowed remote attackers to upload PHP shells. expected.summary: Critical unauth file-upload-to-shell in WP Forminator plugin <1.31.0 (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 9.8; 500k installs). Update + scan uploads/forminator/.

rationale: Scan instruction critical when shells may already be present.

Severity: Medium. Patches in OpenJDK 22.0.1, 21.0.3, 17.0.11, 11.0.23, 8u411. Upgrade via your distribution; commercial vendors (Oracle, Azul, Amazon Corretto) shipping equivalent backports.

expected.summary: Medium HTTP/2 memory-exhaustion in OpenJDK java.net.http client (CVE-2024-XXXX). Upgrade to 22.0.1 / 21.0.3 / 17.0.11 / 11.0.23 / 8u411 or vendor backports.

expected.summary: Critical unauth password change for any user in Cisco SSM On-Prem (CVE-2024-20419, CVSS 10.0). Patch to 8-202212+ immediately.

rationale: 10.0 CVSS + 'any user including admin' is alarming.

Severity: Medium. Mitigation: firmware update from CPU vendor + Linux kernel update. Requires significant attacker capability; real-world exploitability rated low.

expected.summary: Medium AMD SEV-SNP confidential-VM leak via 'StackRot' speculative load (CVE-2024-XXXX); low practical exploitability. Apply CPU firmware + kernel updates.

input.advisory: GitHub Advanced Security disclosed that on May 30, 2024, a backend service deploying CodeQL pack updates briefly served packs with a known stale dependency. No CodeQL pack contained malicious code. Customers running affected Actions workflows during the window may have run scans with outdated detection rules; rerun affected scans.

expected.summary: GitHub Advanced Security served CodeQL packs with stale dependency on 2024-05-30 (no malicious code). Rerun any CodeQL scans from that window.

rationale: Effectively a re-scan instruction, not a patch.

input.advisory: Trend Micro Apex One 14.0.0.12380 patches CVE-2024-XXXX, an OS command injection in the dashboard backend reachable by authenticated administrators. Severity: High (CVSS 8.8). Workaround: restrict dashboard access to a management LAN. Trend Micro confirmed exploitation in a single customer environment prior to disclosure.

expected.summary: High auth'd cmd-injection in Trend Micro Apex One dashboard (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 8.8); exploited at 1 customer pre-disclosure. Patch or scope to mgmt LAN.

Severity: Medium. Mitigation: enable 'smtpd_data_restrictions = reject_unauth_pipelining'. Fixed permanently in Postfix 3.8.5+.

expected.summary: Medium SMTP smuggling / SPF bypass in Postfix (CVE-2023-51764). Upgrade to 3.8.5+ or set `smtpd_data_restrictions = reject_unauth_pipelining`.

rationale: Config-snippet workaround is the actionable for ops.

input.advisory: Datadog Agent 7.53.0 patches CVE-2024-XXXX, an improper handling of TLS certificates in the live-process intake endpoint. Under specific network conditions, the agent could transmit telemetry over an insecure connection without erroring. Severity: Medium. No malicious actor activity observed.

expected.summary: Medium TLS-validation gap in Datadog Agent <7.53.0 live-process intake (CVE-2024-XXXX). Upgrade; no observed exploitation.

rationale: Telemetry-pipeline TLS is operationally important; conservatively phrased.

input.advisory: Apple Magic Keyboard (Bluetooth) is affected by CVE-2024-XXXX, a session-establishment flaw allowing a nearby attacker to inject keystrokes into a paired host. expected.summary: High nearby-attacker keystroke injection on Bluetooth Apple Magic Keyboard (CVE-2024-XXXX, CVSS 7.8). Firmware via macOS 14.5 / iOS 17.5; unpair in untrusted areas.

expected.summary: SCARLETEEL 2.0 campaign exploits unpatched Apache RocketMQ (CVE-2023-33246) for AWS credential theft. Patch to 5.1.2+ / 4.9.7+ and rotate AWS creds on affected hosts.

input.advisory: Adobe Reader and Acrobat received an out-of-band advisory for CVE-2024-XXXX (CVSS 9.8), a heap-based buffer overflow allowing arbitrary code execution via a malicious PDF. expected.summary: Low AppArmor regression on Ubuntu 22.04 (USN-6711-1) let unconfined snaps bypass netns. Apt update to 3.0.4-2ubuntu2.4.

input.advisory: Tor Browser 13.0.16 patches CVE-2024-XXXX, a privacy issue where a malicious page can trigger DNS resolution outside the Tor circuit under specific WebRTC conditions. expected.summary: Medium DNS-leak-outside-Tor-circuit via WebRTC in Tor Browser <13.0.16 (CVE-2024-XXXX); privacy issue, no RCE. Restart browser to apply.

expected.summary: Entra ID 6h sign-in disruption in EU North on 2024-06-04 (metadata replication); no data impact. PIR published; service credits applied.

expected.summary: Outlook iOS/Android server-side fix on 2024-05-22 for shared-mailbox permission overshare to unlicensed clients. No customer action; auto-resolved.

Patched in Nextcloud Hub 28.0.4 / 27.1.8 / 26.0.13.
